title: Grateful Dead Live at Barton Hall, Cornell University on 1977-05-08
source: Source: Betty Cantor's SBD Reel Master > PCM (undecoded) > DAT via spdif/Sony PCM601esd > wav file via spdif/RME multiface > Wave 24/48 (decoded) > Myteck Stereo DAC96 > DBX150X > Korg MR2000 > WAV 24/48

ai_review.summary: Betty's sound‑board transfer sounds muffled and unbalanced, with no standout musical moments mentioned in the reviews.
ai_review.review: The few fan comments focus on the poor audio fidelity of this Betty‑sourced soundboard – listeners note a heavy side bias and overall muddiness compared to other transfers. No specific songs or performance highlights are cited, leaving the musical quality of the show unaddressed.

ai_rating.rationale: Two high‑star reviews lack substantive commentary, while a low‑star review highlights serious recording flaws; with limited performance data the overall rating settles around an average mark.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Unbalanced left/right bias, muffled sound, does not match previous transfers; reviewers suggest commercial release sounds far better.
